name: A tilted mosaic wall proves range
looks: Dozens of distinct generated images tile together in a slightly tilted grid, filling the whole frame edge to edge with no two alike, a headline fading in over the top claiming the scale behind it ("Thousands of proven prompts.").
build: Mosaic tiles are a fixed tilted grid (a few degrees of rotation on the whole wall), no individual tile animation beyond a slow, barely-perceptible parallax drift on the wall as a whole. The headline fades/lifts in over it (`y:8px -> 0`, ~300ms) once the wall is established.
sound: A low ambient pad under the wall, a soft swell as the headline lands.
prompt: Fill the whole frame with a tilted wall of many distinct generated images tiled edge to edge, no two alike, then fade in a headline over it that claims the scale of the library behind it, letting the density of the wall itself make the case.
